package.name: mower_docking
package.description: Docking / undocking action server for the Airseekers Tron (ROS 2 Humble). Re-implements the vendor mower_charge behaviour: Nav2 to the approach pose, rear-camera ArUco (DICT_4X4_50) guided reverse onto the charger, contact debounce on is_docking_done, /charging on; undock = charger off, drive away, wait for RTK fixed.
